hook: Why canners only trust tested recipes

slides.t: A tested recipe was checked in a lab so heat reaches the center of the jar. The time fits that food, that jar size, that recipe.
Extra onions, peppers or less vinegar change the acidity. Then the processing time may no longer be safe.
Don't add flour or cornstarch before canning. Thick food slows the heat. Thicken it when you open the jar.
Open-kettle canning, oven canning and old recipe cards with no processing time are not considered safe today.
A current guide with tested recipes, times for each jar size, and altitude charts. Add time or pressure above 1,000 ft.

hook: A gift for the gardener who has everything
hook_sub: A harvest basket for the garden

slides.t: Pick straight into it, then rinse with the hose. Dirt and water drain out, so produce goes in the kitchen clean.
Most vegetables are cool and crisp early in the day. By afternoon, greens and herbs start to wilt.
Heavy squash and potatoes go on the bottom. Tomatoes, berries and greens go on top, so nothing gets crushed.
Don't leave a full basket in the sun. Move it to shade and cool the harvest soon after picking.
A sturdy handle, a rust-resistant frame, and a size they can still carry when it's full.
